{"failure_class": "closing step skipped",
 "root_cause": "The agent made the main update and finished. The request ended with a closing step, logging a follow-up task for the contact, and the agent's last message says nothing in its instructions covers closing steps of this kind. The only failed check is the follow-up task.",
 "mechanism": "Extend the working note on closing steps: when a request ends by asking to log a follow-up task for the contact, create that task with the title the request gives before finishing.",
 "component": "memory",
 "generality": "Same class as the skipped closing post and tag: the agent stops after the main update whenever the closing step is of a kind its note does not name. Naming follow-up tasks covers every request that ends with one."}
